For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Manoranjan Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mrs. Meena Singh  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL KUMAR PANWAR  ORAL ORDER 5 15-12-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The instant application for regular bail has been filed by the petitioner registered for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376, 376(3)/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4,8,6,10 of the POCSO Act.
Prosecution case relates to abduction of daughter of the informant and one other girl by the petitioner and 11 other accused persons .
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
Both victim girls went to Delhi with the petitioner and returned after two days.
Statement of both the victim girls was recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C. in which they have not made any allegation of physical or sexual abuse against the petitioner.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.51417 of 2023(5) dt.15-12-2023
Petitioner ha got no criminal antecedent and languishing in judicial custody since 8.9.2022.
Learned APP appearing for the State has opposed the prayer of Bail.
